name: ATC_PUBLISH_DESTINATIONS
description: This table store the details of Enterprise Catalog Publish destinations

columns.name: DEST_MODE
columns.description: Mode of the destination as in external vs internal

columns.name: ENTRY_LIFECYCLE_STATUS
columns.description: Entry status for the Publishing to the      destination.

columns.name: DESTINATION_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the destination

columns.name: DESTINATION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the destination (whether it is CPQ,OCC or CUSTOM)

columns.name: DESTINATION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Indicates the description of the destination

columns.name: DEST_VERSION
columns.description: This stores the version of the destination

columns.name: DESTINATION_URL
columns.description: Contains the URL of the destination

columns.name: DESTINATION_CHARACTERISTICS
columns.description: Stores JSON data for destinations characteristics

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
